name: Random Grid
comment: Tiles the back wall with a grid of cards, each a random face button, bumper, stick click or trigger, like Tortellini's own tank. "generate" makes LayoutPresets.read() lay the cards out afresh each time the preset is loaded (see LayoutPresets.random_grid()); save it under another name to keep one. Decor is kept to the front, clear of the grid.
